title: Man discovers his parents' coffee machine used 1TB of data in 10 days
why_read: A concrete and slightly absurd story about embedded device telemetry gone wrong, interesting for IoT/networking engineers.
analysis: The story describes a smart coffee machine quietly consuming a terabyte of data in just ten days, which is a real anomaly worth diagnosing. It likely touches on topics like excessive polling, misconfigured cloud sync, or chatty IoT firmware that engineers building connected devices should care about. It is a lighter, human-interest technical story rather than deep engineering content, but the root cause analysis could be genuinely instructive. Good cautionary tale about IoT telemetry design.
